actualAvailableContracts.preconditions: Same object implements IVersionedSettingsStore and IResourceStoreIdentitySource; actual actor exists and matches expected; root schema1/stable nonempty StoreID. The expected actor is a constraint, never authority.
actualAvailableContracts.fence: Dispose() Interlocked sets revoked. OriginalActor.GetCurrentAsync returns null when revoked; OriginalIdentity refuses after revoked. Original actor and StoreID are captured privately by the issuer. No public client grant constructor.

actualAvailableContracts.admission: Every change uses canonical expected publication revision, exact serialized CAS, actual IFormStoreCommitAuthority.CaptureCommitAdmissionAsync and FormCommitAdmission wrapping the session-bound actor source. CheckAsync verifies actual root and original actor before and after the inner authority check.
actualAvailableContracts.result: FormPublicationResult(bool Success, string? Code, FormPublication? Publication); no operation key or unknown-create recovery receipt exists in this selected contract.

actualAvailableContracts.nativeEvidence: Actual VersionedAtomicSettingsStore invokes CheckAsync with SettingsCommitPhase.Admission and again SettingsCommitPhase.Publication immediately before durable replacement. This is source evidence, not current browser test acceptance.
actualAvailableContracts.caveat: Native Home ownership and settings are separate stores. The source does not claim an atomic cross-store revocation transaction. A publication completed before revocation can still have a lost/uncertain reply.

actualAvailableContracts.boundary: Native personal authority explicitly refuses AccountId or OrganisationId. Local fixture positive ownership never authorises a web/private principal. A declared public Form audience does not confer respondent access.

actualAvailableContracts.state: Actual per-field/option/column/table inspector drafts and original Title are retained in the owner workspace object. No durable private-draft capture/quarantine/recovery port exposed. Browser must not flatten bindings or serialize new private domain records.

Current owned adapter implements IDisposable and IBrowserCloseParticipant only. PrepareToClose refuses busy/dirty/uncertain state; Dispose clears references and synchronously disposes captured FormHostSession, then cancels presentation lifetime. No IAsyncDisposable or full in-flight task drain exists. Opening candidates are not in the pending-view map until InitializeAsync completes.
actualAvailableContracts.neededClosure: Immediate fence must reach actual already-issued and opening owner sessions, even before candidate registration, then await/drain every open/command. Cancellation alone is not proof a remote or native owner stopped. Host factory must admit/register issued sessions under current actor generation before any private operation or provide the actual owner-group revocation handle.

sameBoundOwnerKeys.authoritative: Actual AuthenticatedResourceActor (ActorId/ProfileId/AccountId/OrganisationId/AuthenticationRevision), actual schema1 StoreID, canonical FormID, expected publication revision and project revision, optional actual FormVersionID/ResponseID for the separate response runtime.
sameBoundOwnerKeys.sourceOfKeys: Issuer/current services and canonical source only. Client IDs/revisions constrain destination/CAS; they do not choose identity/ACL/authority. FormHostSession captures root/actor privately.
sameBoundOwnerKeys.sessionFreshness: Same original actor/root/session must guard opens, retained binding admission, owner mutations, final commit and recovery lookup; new account/context cannot adopt an old owner.

ordinaryCloseWhileAuthorised: Await existing PrepareToCloseAsync while the original actor/root remains current. Unsaved inspector/uncreated title/uncertain outcome returns FormsUnsavedChanges and retains the owner/draft; no automatic mass-save or silent discard.

User may issue the original explicit SaveField/Create or DiscardInspector/restore-title operation with ordinary owner checks. CAS conflict/permission denial/unknown outcome must not be converted to successful close.
Only after successful preparation detach maps/surfaces; then synchronously fence owner sessions and await/drain lifetime cleanup. Preparation failure leaves the original admitted owner intact.
signOutAccountSwitchOrRevokedActor: First invalidate the actual authenticated owner/session authority. Synchronously invoke the actual original-session fence (FormHostSession.Dispose) for all old owner sessions, invalidate pending navigation/admission and detach all private route/binding/accessibility references before awaiting external cleanup or executing cancellation/presentation callbacks.

Fence scope includes owner sessions issued during an in-flight factory/open before they enter the route pending map; generation-bound owner factory must reject or revoke stale completion, and cleanup must await its drain. Current route does not yet supply this full issued-session ledger.

This path must not call save-before-close or let FormsUnsavedChanges veto revocation. The revoked actor cannot commit inspector cleanup, autosave, retry or changed intent; do not substitute the newly logged-in actor.

After authority/presentation detachment cancel operations and await all pending task disposal; attempt every release even if one callback fails. Report aggregated cleanup errors after all private owners are fenced/detached. DeviceLocal owners are separately scoped and retain their existing authorised local owner, without relabelling private Forms.

If a real owner has durable draft quarantine/recovery, retain only its permission-bound opaque recovery reference. In its absence immediately clear private presentation/in-memory drafts and report that recovery is unavailable; do not claim revoked drafts were saved or silently export them.

Reopen/recovery requires a fresh issuer-created session that independently admits the original current principal/root/ACL and exact source/revision. Another actor, organisation or replaced root cannot receive the private draft or pending mutation.
unknownMutation: No mutation replay after uncertain outcome. Actual local postcommit IOException becomes StorageUnavailable; adapter blocks further writes and closure until permitted original owner recovery.
For an edit, read actual canonical saved state under the same owner; explicit discard acknowledges retained inspector after reconciliation. This is not an idempotency contract.

For unknown creation without returned FormID the current authoring API generated the ID internally and exposes no operation lookup. Request a maintained owner recovery/receipt contract; never invent a new operation key or browse a foreign root to infer the lost created artifact.

If revoked during unknown outcome, fence immediately and reconcile only through a newly authorised same-owner recovery service. A pre-revocation durable commit may exist; teardown must not mislabel it undone or failed without evidence.

Sign-out/revocation with dirty and unknown state fences synchronously; no late binding/pending-admission reveals old private content and no automatic save uses either old or new actor.

Paused real owner commit revoked before admission and before final publication denies without settings mutation; already-published commit/lost receipt is reconciled as uncertain using maintained same-owner recovery.
Registered owner cancellation/teardown failures cannot retain authority or skip other private releases; unrelated DeviceLocal durable projects remain alive.
Pending async open and prepared-but-unadmitted original CUI expire on revocation; consumed navigation cancellation alone does not revoke a current admitted owner.
Recovery/private draft/response rejected for wrong principal/account/org/root/revision; maintained same owner explicit recovery preserves schema/identity/content.
Actual browser provider/restart, current authenticated actor/permission negatives and public respondent transport tested independently from native fixtures before browser shipping acceptance.
